A line-break-only emphasis nested inside an otherwise empty strong wrapper still separates the words on either side

```ruby title="Ruby"
require "html_to_markdown"
result = HtmlToMarkdown.convert('<p><strong>Alpha</strong><strong><em><br></em></strong>Beta</p>')
puts result.content.inspect
```
